``` {r MakeYearlyDF}

# NOT PULLING OUT REFERERNCE POINTS. WHYYYYY
# FBAR IS AGE SPECIFIC, I'M ONLY USING OLDEST
# DO WE DO TRANSFORMATIONS ON LOG STUFF. NOTED BELOW

# Possible other things to include:


# PROJECTIONS
Proj_ests <- data.frame(Year = c(),
                      EM_name = c(),
                      seed_no = c(),
                      Temp_OM = c(),
                      Temp_OM_Obs = c(),
                      Temp_EM = c(),
                      Temp_EM_Obs = c(),
                      SSB = c(), # SSB_real
                      FBar = c(), #f bar OM
                      Pred_catch = c(), #Predited catch om
                      Catch_advice = c(),  # catch Advice from EM
                      #THESE STILL AREN'T RUNNING. WHY
                      # log_FMSY_stat = c(), #IN LOG SPACE. TRANSFORM
                      # log_SSB_FXSPR_stat = c(), #IN LOG SPACE. TRANSFORM
                      # log_FBar_SXPR_stat = c() #IN LOG SPACE. TRANSFORM
                      recPars_a = c(), #IN LOG SPACE. TRANSFORM ? # EM Stock Recruit Relationship 1
                      recPars_b = c(), #IN LOG SPACE. TRANSFORM ? # EM Stock Recruit Relationship 1
                      Ecov_processPars_mean = c(),#IN LOG SPACE. TRANSFORM ? # mean ecov param
                      Ecov_processPars_sd = c(),#IN LOG SPACE. TRANSFORM ? # sd ecov param
                      Ecov_processPars_logit_rho = c()) #logitrho for ecov param

mods <- Mods_proj
for(i in 1:length(Mods_proj)){ # i = seed, j = model
  for(k in 1:length(ModNames_proj)){
    tryCatch({
      
      years <- min(mods[[i]][[paste0("Mod",k)]][["em_full"]][[1]][["years"]]):(max(mods[[i]][[paste0("Mod",k)]][["em_full"]][[1]][["years"]]) + 5) #Year
    em_name <- rep(ModNames_proj[k], length(years)) # Model Name
    Seed <- rep(i, length(years))
      # Ecov_x estimates
    om_ecovx <- mods[[i]][[paste0("Mod",k)]][["om"]][["rep"]][["Ecov_x"]] #OM_ecov Temps
    om_ecovObs <- mods[[i]][[paste0("Mod",k)]][["om"]][["input"]][["data"]][["Ecov_obs"]] # om obs temps
    em_ecovx <- mods[[i]][[paste0("Mod",k)]][["em_full"]][[1]][["rep"]][["Ecov_x"]] #EM_ecov Temps
    em_ecovObs <- mods[[i]][[paste0("Mod",k)]][["em_input"]][[1]][["data"]][["Ecov_obs"]] # em obs temps
    # Ecov_Obs estimates
    SSB_om <- mods[[i]][[paste0("Mod",k)]][["om"]][["rep"]][["SSB"]] #SSB
    FBar_om <- mods[[i]][[paste0("Mod",k)]][["om"]][["rep"]][["Fbar"]] #Fbar
    pred_catch_om <- mods[[i]][[paste0("Mod",k)]][["om"]][["rep"]][["pred_catch"]] #pred catch
    cat_advice_em <-  c(rep(NA, 51),unlist(mods[[i]][[paste0("Mod",k)]][["catch_advice"]]), NA)
    # FMSY <- mods[[i]][[paste0("Mod",k)]][["om"]][["rep"]][["log_FMSY_static"]]
    # SSB_FXSPR <- mods[[i]][[paste0("Mod",k)]][["om"]][["rep"]][["log_SSB_FXSPR_static"]]
    # FBar_SXPR <- mods[[i]][[paste0("Mod",k)]][["om"]][["rep"]][["log_Fbar_XSPR_static"]]
    recpar_a <- rep(mods[[i]][[paste0("Mod",k)]][['par.est']][[1]]$mean_rec_pars[,1], length(years))
    recpar_b <- rep(mods[[i]][[paste0("Mod",k)]][['par.est']][[1]]$mean_rec_pars[,2], length(years))
    ecov_processpar_mean <- rep(mods[[i]][[paste0("Mod",k)]][['par.est']][[1]]$Ecov_process_pars[1,], length(years))
    ecov_processpar_sd <- rep(mods[[i]][[paste0("Mod",k)]][['par.est']][[1]]$Ecov_process_pars[2,], length(years))
    ecov_processpar_logit_rho <- rep(mods[[i]][[paste0("Mod",k)]][['par.est']][[1]]$Ecov_process_pars[3,], length(years))
    
    data_List <- data.frame(Year = years,
                      EM_name = em_name,
                      seed_no = Seed,
                      Temp_OM = om_ecovx[1:100,],
                      Temp_OM_Obs = om_ecovObs[1:100,],
                      Temp_EM = em_ecovx[1:100,],
                      Temp_EM_Obs = em_ecovObs[1:100,],
                      SSB = SSB_om,
                      FBar = FBar_om[,1], #AGE SPECIFIC. ONLY DOING OLDEST AGE GROUP OFR F BAR
                      Pred_catch = pred_catch_om,
                      Catch_advice = cat_advice_em,
                      # log_FMSY_stat = FMSY,
                      # log_SSB_FXSPR_stat = SSB_FXSPR,
                      # log_FBar_SXPR_stat = FBar_SXPR
                      recPars_a = recpar_a, #IN LOG SPACE. TRANSFORM?
                      recPars_b = recpar_b, #IN LOG SPACE. TRANSFORM?
                      Ecov_processPars_mean = ecov_processpar_mean,#IN LOG SPACE. TRANSFORM?
                      Ecov_processPars_sd = ecov_processpar_sd,#IN LOG SPACE. TRANSFORM?
                      Ecov_processPars_logit_rho = ecov_processpar_logit_rho)
    
    Proj_ests <- rbind(Proj_ests, data_List)
    
      
    }, error=function(e){})      
  }
}
saveRDS(Proj_ests,'C:/Users/swulfing/Documents/MSE_results/Projections/Projections_data.rds')
```
